ideas.title: The Impact of Minnesota's Welfare Fraud Scandal on Local Communities
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effects of the welfare fraud scandal on local communities in Minnesota, including the financial and emotional toll on those affected.
ideas.angle: The human impact of the scandal
questions: What is the scope of the scandal?
How have local communities been affected?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the real-world consequences of large-scale fraud and the importance of effective program management.
